python3 - <<'PY'
import json,collections
cards=[json.loads(s) for s in open('items.jsonl')]
rows=[json.loads(s) for s in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(rows)==len(cards)
assert [r['card_id'] for r in rows]==[c['card_id'] for c in cards]
assert len({r['card_id'] for r in rows})==len(rows)
required={'card_id','letters','marks','crop_ok','errors','detail','owner_crop','where'}
owner={'one_central_line','text_ne_visible_line','other_complete_line','gt2_whole_neighbour_words','turned_or_clipped'}
for r in rows:
 assert required<=r.keys()
 assert r['letters'] in ['y','n','u'] and r['marks'] in ['y','n','na'] and r['crop_ok'] in ['y','n']
 assert set(r['owner_crop'])==owner
 assert all(v in ['yes','no','uncertain'] for v in r['owner_crop'].values())
 assert all(set(w)=={'label','printed'} for w in r['where'])
print('Cards:',len(rows),'Count and order verified')
for k in ['letters','marks','crop_ok']:print(k,dict(collections.Counter(r[k] for r in rows)))
print('Errors:',collections.Counter(e for r in rows for e in r['errors']).most_common())
